先预测参数改变会影响哪一步，再查看具体运算。: Predict which step the parameter affects, then inspect the calculation.
对易算符在每个不可约块内为标量: A commuting operator is scalar within each irreducible block
与全体群操作对易。: It commutes with every group operation.
加入的ε项已使部分群操作不再与H对易。: The ε term makes H fail to commute with some group operations.
为什么乘上一项不会让群元素丢失、重复？: Why does multiplying every group element neither lose nor duplicate an element?
先知道复合的次序、单位元 e 和逆元 h⁻¹。: Know the order of composition, the identity e and the inverse h⁻¹.
对任意固定的 h∈G，左乘与右乘都是群到自身的双射。有限群的整列元素因此只被重新: For any fixed h∈G, left and right multiplication are bijections of the group. In a finite group, they therefore rearrange the complete list of elements.
在下面S₃实验中选h=(12)。六个输入分别得到六个不同输出。请先找出输出e来自: In the S₃ experiment below, choose h=(12). Six different inputs give six different outputs. Predict which input produces e, then switch to right multiplication. The order generally changes, but both lists contain all six elements.
任意六个动作的列表不自动构成群。若缺了逆元或不封闭，上述构造就没有保证；也不能把: An arbitrary list of six actions need not be a group. Without closure or inverses, this argument does not apply. Rearrangement also does not imply hg=gh.
为什么只证明“结果仍在G”还不够？: Why is proving that every output remains in G insufficient?
闭合性只排除跑出集合，尚未排除多个输入得到同一输出。逆元允许消去h，单射与满射才: Closure only rules out leaving the set; it does not rule out repeated outputs. Inverses let us cancel h, establishing the injectivity and surjectivity needed for a complete rearrangement.
先说明映射的对象: Define the map and its domain
定义左乘映射 Lh(g)=hg。闭合性保证每个结果仍在G，故这确实是G到G的映射: Let Lh(g)=hg. Closure guarantees that every output remains in G, so this is a map from G to itself.
证明不会重复：单射: Prove that outputs cannot repeat: injectivity
若两个输入得到同一结果，在等式两边左乘h⁻¹。使用结合律，再用h⁻¹h=e，两个: If two inputs have the same output, multiply on the left by h⁻¹. Associativity and h⁻¹h=e then force the inputs to be equal.
证明不会遗漏：满射: Prove that no output is missing: surjectivity
任取想得到的目标y，主动构造输入g=h⁻¹y。它属于G，而且左乘h后正好得到y。: For any desired output y, construct g=h⁻¹y. This belongs to G and multiplication by h sends it to y.
先左乘h、再左乘h⁻¹能恢复所有输入，两种次序都成立。右乘映射也有右乘h⁻¹作为: Left multiplication by h followed by h⁻¹ restores every input, in either order. Right multiplication similarly has multiplication by h⁻¹ on the right as its inverse.
从双射得到群平均不变: Deduce invariance of a group average
有限群的求和遍历的是同一集合，因此变量g换成hg或gh不会改变总和。后面的幺正化: The finite sum visits exactly the same elements after replacing g by hg or gh. This is the step used later in unitarization and orthogonality.
同一种操作换一个参照，为什么特征标不变？: Why does the character stay the same when an operation is viewed in a different reference?
复合按右到左作用；hgh⁻¹表示先回到旧参照、做g，再回到新参照。: Composition acts from right to left: hgh⁻¹ returns to the old reference, applies g, then moves to the new reference.
共轭把群划分成互不重叠的类。表示的特征标在每一类上为常数，因此可以按类而不是逐元: Conjugacy partitions a group into disjoint classes. The character of a representation is constant on each class, so information can be organized by class instead of element.
下面把g选为一个对换，再逐个改变h。矩阵的位置会变，但迹一直是1；换为三循环时迹: Choose a transposition for g, then vary h below. The nonzero matrix entries move, but the trace remains 1. For a three-cycle the trace is 0. Thus the class characters (3,1,0) of the three-dimensional permutation representation come from actual matrices.
同阶元素在一般群里不一定共轭。一个共轭类也不一定是子群，因为它通常不含单位元。: Elements of equal order need not be conjugate in a general group. A conjugacy class need not be a subgroup; it usually does not contain the identity.
为什么约化公式中的对换项要乘3？: Why is the transposition term multiplied by 3 in the reduction formula?
三个对换属于同一类，特征标相同。把六项逐元素求和合并成三项按类求和时，这一类出现: The three transpositions belong to one class and have equal characters. Combining the six element terms into three class terms counts that class three times.
h⁻¹先把参照移回去，g做原操作，h再把参照送到新位置。它一般改变操作的轴或被置: First h⁻¹ returns to the old reference, then g performs the action, and finally h restores the new reference. The axis or the permuted labels generally change.
证明这是等价关系: Prove that conjugacy is an equivalence relation
单位元给出自反；把h换成h⁻¹给出对称；连续两次换参照合并为kh，给出传递。三个: The identity gives reflexivity; replacing h by h⁻¹ gives symmetry; combining two changes of reference into kh gives transitivity. Each element therefore belongs to exactly one class.
直接在S₃里构造一类: Construct a class directly in S₃
从(12)出发，改变h会得到(12)、(23)、(13)，但得不到三循环。恒等自: Starting from (12), varying h produces (12), (23) and (13), but never a three-cycle. The identity forms one class, and the two three-cycles form another.
表示矩阵随共轭发生相似变换: Translate conjugation into a similarity transformation
由表示保持乘法以及D(h⁻¹)=D(h)⁻¹，得到相似矩阵。相似不意味着矩阵每个: The representation law and D(h⁻¹)=D(h)⁻¹ give similar matrices. Similarity does not mean that all their entries coincide.
对角元之和为何相同: Explain why the sum of diagonal entries agrees
用迹的循环性质把D(h)移到最后，两项相消。这样得到类函数，不需要预先假设表示不: Cyclic invariance of the trace moves D(h) to the end, where it cancels its inverse. The character is therefore a class function, even for a reducible representation.
若两个h产生同一个共轭结果，它们相差一个与g对易的元素。等价的h按中心化子分组，: Two choices of h give the same conjugate precisely when they differ by an element commuting with g. Grouping the choices by the centralizer yields the counting formula.
什么时候可以把整个子群看成一个新单位元？: When can an entire subgroup be treated as a new identity?
左陪集gH是把H中所有元素统一左乘g；陪集是集合，不是单个元素。: The left coset gH consists of all elements of H multiplied by g on the left. A coset is a set, not one element.
H正规当且仅当每个g都满足gHg⁻¹=H。此时陪集间的乘法与代表元无关，才能构成: H is normal precisely when gHg⁻¹=H for every g. Only then does multiplication of cosets give an answer independent of the representatives, defining the quotient group G/H.
选择A₃时，下面能列出两元素商群的乘法表。换成二阶子群，再选h=(23)，观察共: Choose A₃ to obtain the multiplication table of a two-element quotient. Then choose the order-two subgroup and h=(23); its conjugate changes. The resulting coset labels cannot simply be treated as a quotient group.
只检查h=e没有信息，因为任何子群都会通过。正规性要求所有h；正规子群也不要求它: Checking only h=e gives no information, because every subgroup passes. Normality concerns every h and does not require every element of H to commute with the full group.
正规子群与群中心有什么区别？: How does a normal subgroup differ from the center?
中心要求每个元素在共轭后逐个不动；正规子群只要求整个集合不变，集合中的元素仍可互: A central element stays individually fixed under every conjugation. A normal subgroup only stays fixed as a set; its members may be permuted within that set.
先区分子群与正规子群: Distinguish a subgroup from a normal subgroup
子群只要求在自己的乘法下仍成群。正规还要求用全群中任何元素换参照，都回到同一个子: A subgroup is a group under its own inherited multiplication. Normality additionally requires conjugation by every element of the full group to preserve the whole subgroup.
从共轭不变得到左右陪集相同: Relate conjugation invariance to equal left and right cosets
把gHg⁻¹=H两边的集合右乘g，得到gH=Hg。反向乘g⁻¹也可恢复共轭不变，: Multiply gHg⁻¹=H on the right by g to obtain gH=Hg. Multiplication by g⁻¹ reverses the argument, so the conditions are equivalent.
尝试定义新乘法: Propose multiplication for the new objects
自然候选是把代表元a和b相乘，再取所在陪集。但是同一陪集可选很多代表元，必须证明: A natural definition multiplies representatives a and b, then takes their coset. Since each coset has many representatives, independence of that choice must be proved.
取a′=ah₁、b′=bh₂。将中间的h₁移到b右边需要共轭；正规性保证移过去的: Write a′=ah₁ and b′=bh₂. Moving h₁ past b introduces a conjugation. Normality keeps that conjugate in H, so the product still lies in abH.
新单位是H，aH的逆是a⁻¹H，结合律继承自G。正规性解决的关键是上一步的“良定: The new identity is H, the inverse of aH is a⁻¹H, and associativity is inherited from G. Normality was needed to make the multiplication well defined before these axioms could be inherited.
A₃包含e和两个三循环，共轭后集合保持不变，S₃/A₃有两个元素。只含e与(12: A₃ contains e and the two three-cycles and is preserved by conjugation; S₃/A₃ has two elements. The subgroup containing only e and (12) is conjugated into a different subgroup.
不能同时拆开，究竟是指什么不能拆？: What exactly must fail to split simultaneously?
矩阵表示满足D(gh)=D(g)D(h)。不变子空间是对所有g都保持不变的同一个: A matrix representation satisfies D(gh)=D(g)D(h). An invariant subspace is the same subspace preserved by every g.
复不可约表示不存在非零、非全空间的共同不变子空间。有限群表示可以借助不变内积分解: A complex irreducible representation has no common invariant subspace other than zero and the whole space. A finite-group representation can be decomposed into irreducible blocks using an invariant inner product.
三顶点置换的特征标为(3,1,0)，自内积(9+3)/6=2，得到A₁⊕E。切换: For the three-vertex representation, (3,1,0) gives self-inner-product (9+3)/6=2 and A₁⊕E. Switching to E gives (4+2)/6=1. Change the selected operation and observe how directions within the E plane mix.
复不可约是本页结论的域条件。实数域上的不可约性与Schur引理形式需另行讨论；一: Complex irreducibility is the domain condition here. Real irreducibility and real versions of Schur's lemma require separate discussion. Eigenvectors of one matrix do not establish common invariant subspaces of the group.
二维E中一个反射型矩阵有两条本征直线，为什么不等于两个一维表示？: A reflection-type matrix in E has two eigenlines. Why are these not two one-dimensional representations?
还要检查另一个生成元；三循环会把这些直线转到别的方向。两条线不是全群共同不变子空: They must also be invariant under the other generator. A three-cycle rotates these lines into other directions, so they are not common invariant subspaces.
从向量而不是单个矩阵定义: Define invariance using vectors, not one matrix
若W中的任意向量经任何群操作仍在W，W才是不变子空间。只对某一个操作不变的方向不: Every vector of W must remain in W under every group operation. A direction preserved by just one operation is insufficient.
构造三顶点的显然不变方向: Find an invariant direction for three vertices
三维置换矩阵只改变坐标次序，因此三个分量相同的向量始终不变。它张成一维A₁子空间: Permutation matrices only reorder components, so a vector with equal components is fixed. It spans the one-dimensional A₁ subspace.
坐标和为零的所有向量组成二维平面；置换保持分量之和，所以这个平面也不变。选一组归: Vectors whose components sum to zero form a plane. Permutations preserve the sum, so the plane is invariant. Choose normalized orthogonal vectors u and v.
把共同不变空间变成分块矩阵: Turn common invariant spaces into matrix blocks
用三列s,u,v组成正交换基矩阵B。每个D(g)都同时分成一维块和二维块，而不是: Use s,u,v as the columns of an orthogonal basis matrix B. Every D(g) splits simultaneously into a one-dimensional block and a two-dimensional block, instead of diagonalizing just one chosen matrix.
为什么补空间一般也能保持不变: Explain why an invariant complement exists in general
有限群先用群平均得到不变内积。若w⊥W，则⟨D(g)w,v⟩=⟨w,D(g⁻¹): Group averaging gives an invariant inner product. If w is orthogonal to W, then ⟨D(g)w,v⟩=⟨w,D(g⁻¹)v⟩=0. Its orthogonal complement is therefore invariant too, and repeated splitting yields irreducible blocks.
大正交定理给出特征标自内积等于重数平方和。因此非零表示的自内积为1，当且仅当恰好: Orthogonality gives the character self-inner-product as a sum of squared multiplicities. For a nonzero representation it equals 1 exactly when one irreducible block occurs once.
为什么完整对称性会强迫一个算符在不可约块内为常数？: Why does full symmetry force an operator to be constant within an irreducible block?
交织算符A:Vα→Vβ满足A Dα(g)=Dβ(g) A。这里使用有限维复表示。: An intertwiner A:Vα→Vβ satisfies A Dα(g)=Dβ(g) A. Representations are finite-dimensional and complex.
两个不等价不可约表示之间的交织算符只能为零；一个复不可约表示内的自交织算符只能是: An intertwiner between inequivalent irreducible representations is zero. A self-intertwiner of a complex irreducible representation is λI.
下面在三维置换空间改变a、b，即使a≠b，M仍与所有群矩阵对易，因为它对A₁和E: Vary a and b in the three-dimensional permutation space. Even when a≠b, M commutes with the whole group because it is constant separately on A₁ and E. In a single E block, all directions share the same a.
Schur引理要求对全群交织，不能由只与一个旋转矩阵对易就推出M=λI。反幺正对: Schur's lemma requires intertwining for the full group. Commuting with one rotation matrix is insufficient. Antiunitary symmetries and real representations require additional structure.
为什么一个对称Hamiltonian仍能有多个能级？: Why can a symmetric Hamiltonian still have several energy levels?
整个状态空间通常是可约的，不同不可约块以及重复副本可以对应不同能量。Schur只: The full state space is usually reducible. Different irreducible blocks and repeated copies can have different energies. Schur's lemma constrains the interior of each irreducible block.
先看核为什么不变: Show that the kernel is invariant
若Av=0，则A Dα(g)v=Dβ(g)Av=0，所以ker A是Vα的不变子: If Av=0, then A Dα(g)v=Dβ(g)Av=0. Hence ker A is an invariant subspace of Vα.
再看像为什么不变: Show that the image is invariant
若w=Av，则Dβ(g)w=A Dα(g)v仍属于像空间。不可约性因此同时限制核: If w=Av, then Dβ(g)w=A Dα(g)v remains in the image. Irreducibility therefore constrains both kernel and image.
非零交织必须可逆: A nonzero intertwiner must be invertible
A非零意味着像不是零，所以像=Vβ；核不能为整个Vα，因此核=0。A于是给出表示: A nonzero image must be all of Vβ, and the kernel must be zero. Thus A is an equivalence isomorphism. For inequivalent representations, only A=0 remains.
利用复数域保证本征值存在: Use existence of an eigenvalue over the complex field
对自交织算符M选择一个本征值λ。M−λI也对易于所有D(g)，而且存在非零核。上: Choose an eigenvalue λ of a self-intertwiner M. The operator M−λI still intertwines and has a nonzero kernel. If it were nonzero, the preceding argument would make it invertible, a contradiction.
写出块内的最终限制: State the restriction within one block
所以M=λI。这不是说所有对称算符在整个物理Hilbert空间都只能有一个参数，: Therefore M=λI. This does not require one common parameter across an entire physical Hilbert space; the statement concerns a single irreducible representation.
说明可约与重复副本的区别: Separate reducible spaces from repeated equivalent copies
若V=A₁⊕E，则允许两个不同常数a、b。若同一个不可约表示出现m次，对称算符还: For A₁⊕E, two constants a and b are allowed. If one irreducible representation occurs m times, a symmetric operator may mix the copies in the m-dimensional multiplicity space.
原矩阵不保长度，为什么仍能换成幺正表示？: If the original matrices do not preserve length, how can they become unitary?
D(g)可逆，但当前坐标基未必正交。†表示复共轭转置，不是单纯转置。: Each D(g) is invertible, but its coordinate basis need not be orthogonal. † denotes the conjugate transpose.
每个有限群的有限维复表示都存在正定不变内积，因此等价于幺正表示。: Every finite-dimensional complex representation of a finite group admits a positive invariant inner product and is therefore equivalent to a unitary representation.
调大剪切或尺度，当前矩阵在普通坐标中越来越不保欧氏长度。分别选择群平均度量与由原: Increase shear or scale: the original coordinate matrices increasingly fail to preserve ordinary Euclidean length. Both the averaged metric and the metric inherited from the original basis change restore an invariant inner product. Compare the actual matrices before and after changing basis.
“等价于幺正”不意味着你手里的原矩阵已经幺正。有限性在这份有限求和证明中不可省；: Equivalent to unitary does not mean the original matrices are already unitary. Finiteness is essential to this finite-sum proof; infinite groups need a suitable invariant measure and additional conditions.
为什么不能简单把每个矩阵分别做一次正交化？: Why not orthogonalize each matrix separately?
分别正交化通常会破坏D(gh)=D(g)D(h)。这里使用同一个C对所有矩阵同时: Separate orthogonalization generally destroys D(gh)=D(g)D(h). Using the same C in a simultaneous similarity transformation preserves the multiplication law.
从任意普通内积出发，把所有群操作后的内积相加。对应的度量矩阵为M。: Starting with an ordinary inner product, sum the inner products after every group operation. The resulting metric matrix is M.
证明M确实正定: Prove that M is positive definite
M显然Hermitian。任取非零v，每个D(g)都可逆，因此D(g)v非零，平: M is Hermitian. For nonzero v, every invertible D(g) sends v to a nonzero vector, so the sum of squared lengths is strictly positive.
D(h)†MD(h)中的每一项等于D(gh)†D(gh)。当g遍历G，gh也遍历: Each term of D(h)†MD(h) is D(gh)†D(gh). As g runs through G, so does gh; the sum is unchanged.
把新度量化为标准长度: Convert the metric to ordinary length
正定M可分解为C†C；在新坐标y=Cv中，新内积成为普通的y†y。C通常不是幺正: Positive M has a factorization C†C. In coordinates y=Cv, the new inner product is ordinary y†y. C itself generally is not unitary.
直接验证换基后的幺正性: Verify unitarity after the common basis change
定义U(g)=C D(g) C⁻¹，代入上一步的度量关系，所有C因子消去，得到U: Set U(g)=C D(g) C⁻¹ and insert the metric identity. The C factors cancel and yield U†U=I.
与可约分解相连: Connect the result to complete reducibility
不变内积使不变子空间的正交补也不变，因此有限群复表示能完全分解。几何中画的圆与椭: An invariant inner product makes the orthogonal complement of an invariant subspace invariant. This enables decomposition into irreducibles. The circle and ellipse below describe the metric of one representation in different coordinates.
大量矩阵元相加，为什么最后只剩几个Kronecker符号？: Why does summing matrix elements leave only Kronecker deltas?
先使用幺正不可约表示，并理解Schur引理。α、β标记不等价类型；i,j,k,l: Use unitary irreducible representations and Schur's lemma. α and β label inequivalent types; i,j,k,l label entries.
同一标准幺正不可约表示中的不同矩阵元作为群上的函数彼此正交；相同矩阵元的平方和为: Different matrix entries of standard unitary irreducible representations are orthogonal as functions on the group. The squared norm of one entry is |G|/d.
选择α=β=E且i=k、j=l，下面六项之和是6/2=3。只改变一个下标，正负项: Set α=β=E with i=k and j=l. The six terms below sum to 6/2=3. Change one index and positive and negative terms cancel to zero. With inequivalent types, the answer is zero even for matching indices. Inspect the terms rather than only their total.
矩阵元公式要求声明的幺正标准基。任意非幺正相似变换后的矩阵元不能直接照套；字符本: The entry formula requires the declared unitary standard basis. It cannot be applied unchanged after an arbitrary nonunitary similarity transformation; characters themselves remain similarity-invariant.
特征标正交为何不再带1/d？: Why is there no remaining 1/d in character orthogonality?
特征标要对对角指标求和，共有d项满足Kronecker条件，每项贡献|G|/d；: Summing diagonal indices leaves d matching terms, each contributing |G|/d. Their product is |G|.
先构造一个会自动对易的平均: Construct an average that automatically intertwines
取任意从Vα到Vβ的矩阵A，定义Φ(A)。它先把A换到每个群相关的参照，再求和。: For any matrix A:Vα→Vβ, define Φ(A). Sum A transformed into every group-related reference.
证明群平均成为交织算符: Prove that the average is an intertwiner
对Φ左乘Dβ(h)、右乘Dα(h)†，求和中的g统一换成hg。重排定理使总和不变: Multiply Φ on the left by Dβ(h) and on the right by Dα(h)†. This replaces g by hg in the sum. Rearrangement leaves the sum invariant, which is the intertwining relation.
若α≠β，Schur引理立即给出Φ(A)=0。矩阵元的正交性首先来自“不等价表示: For α≠β, Schur's lemma gives Φ(A)=0. Orthogonality first reflects the absence of nonzero intertwiners between inequivalent irreducibles.
若α=β，Φ(A)=cI。取迹并利用幺正性，每个求和项的迹都是Tr A，于是算出: For α=β, Φ(A)=cI. By unitarity, each term has trace Tr A. Taking the trace determines c and the normalization factor.
用只有一个非零元的A抽取指标: Select entries using a matrix unit
取A=E_lj，其迹是δ_lj，再取Φ的(k,i)元，恰好把四个指标的求和式逐项: Choose A=E_lj, with trace δ_lj. The (k,i) entry of Φ then extracts exactly the four-index summation formula.
把矩阵元正交变成特征标正交: Pass from matrix-entry to character orthogonality
把两个矩阵的对角元分别求和，只有同一不可约类型且同一指标的项留下。再除以群阶，特: Sum both diagonal indices. Only matching representation types and indices contribute. Dividing by the group order gives character inner product 1 or 0.
怎样从一串迹，读出每个不可约块出现几次？: How does a list of traces reveal how often each irreducible block occurs?
知道特征标可按共轭类列表，并已理解字符正交。重数mα不是不可约表示的维数dα。: Characters can be organized by conjugacy class, and irreducible characters are orthogonal. Multiplicity mα differs from dimension dα.
可约表示的特征标是不可约特征标的非负整数线性组合；对某一行做内积，即可抽出该不可: A reducible character is a nonnegative integer combination of irreducible characters. Its inner product with one irreducible character extracts the multiplicity of that type.
下面先选择三顶点置换，再切换正则表示，比较“重数”与“维数”。最后手填一个字符猜: Compare the three-vertex and regular representations below to distinguish multiplicity from dimension. Then enter a proposed character. Negative or noninteger multiplicities rule it out as the character of an actual representation.
按类求和乘一次类大小；逐元素求和则每个元素列一次。两种写法不能混用，也不能仅凭χ: A class sum includes the class size once; an element sum lists every element once. Do not combine these two conventions or accept a row merely because χ(e) is an integer.
三个不可约表示的维数能否是1、1、4？: Could the three irreducible dimensions be 1,1,4?
不行。对六阶S₃，维数平方和必须为6，而1+1+16=18。正确的维数是1、1、: No. For the order-six group S₃, their squares must sum to 6, whereas 1+1+16=18. The dimensions are 1,1,2. The number of irreducible types also equals the three conjugacy classes.
先从分块矩阵取迹: Take the trace of a block decomposition
直和分块的迹等于各块迹之和；同一种不可约块出现m次，贡献就是m倍特征标。: The trace of a direct sum is the sum of block traces. If a type occurs m times, its character contributes m times.
与目标行做内积: Take the inner product with the desired row
把上式乘χα*后遍历群。不同不可约特征标相互正交，求和中只剩目标重数。: Multiply by the conjugate of χα and sum over the group. Orthogonality eliminates every other type, leaving its multiplicity.
把逐元素求和合并为按类求和: Combine element sums into class sums
一类内特征标恒定，所以每项乘这一类的元素数nc。S₃的列顺序在这里固定为恒等、对: Characters are constant within a class, so each class term is weighted by its size nc. Here the order is identity, transpositions, three-cycles, with sizes 1,3,2.
A₁行(1,1,1)、A₂行(1,−1,1)、E行(2,0,−1)。把(3,1,: The rows are A₁=(1,1,1), A₂=(1,−1,1) and E=(2,0,−1). Substituting (3,1,0) term by term gives multiplicities 1,0,1.
在单位元处核对维数: Check the dimension at the identity
Dα(e)=I_dα，故χα(e)=dα。约化前后的总维数必须相同，但维数相同本: Since Dα(e)=I_dα, χα(e)=dα. Dimensions before and after reduction must agree, but that alone does not establish valid multiplicities.
由正则表示看维数平方和: Derive the squared-dimension sum from the regular representation
正则表示的字符是(|G|,0,…)，所以每个不可约表示出现dα次。代回总维数，得: Its character is (|G|,0,…), giving multiplicity dα for each irreducible. Substitution into the total dimension yields the squared-dimension sum.
什么时候表示的维数真的给出能级简并度？: When does a representation dimension actually determine an energy degeneracy?
H是Hermitian，且与群的全部幺正对称操作对易。先区分总状态空间和某一个能: H is Hermitian and commutes with every unitary group operation. Distinguish the full state space from one energy eigenspace.
对称性保护的是不可约多重态的维数d。重复副本和偶然重合可以让总简并度更大；可约表: Symmetry protects a multiplet of dimension d. Repeated copies and accidental coincidences can increase total degeneracy; the dimension of a reducible state space does not automatically give a single energy degeneracy.
先保持ε=0，改变a和b，观察二重E能级始终同能；令a=b制造偶然三重重合，再加: With ε=0, vary a and b and observe that the E partners remain degenerate. Tune a=b to create an accidental threefold coincidence, then introduce ε. Explain the splitting through the changed symmetry condition rather than treating all equal energies alike.
这份论证针对幺正群表示。Kramers简并由反幺正时间反演及T²=−1保证，需要: This argument concerns unitary representations. Kramers degeneracy follows from antiunitary time reversal with T²=−1 and requires the conditions explained in the time-reversal unit.
一个四维空间能否只有两个不同能量，每个二重？: Can a four-dimensional space have two distinct energies, each doubly degenerate?
可以。例如同一个二维不可约表示出现两次，重数空间的2×2 Hermitian矩阵: Yes. Two copies of one two-dimensional irreducible representation have a two-dimensional multiplicity space. Two distinct eigenvalues of its Hermitian matrix each retain two partners.
证明同能量空间在群下不变: Show that an energy eigenspace is invariant
若Hv=Ev，则H D(g)v=D(g)Hv=E D(g)v，所以群操作不会把这: If Hv=Ev, then H D(g)v=D(g)Hv=E D(g)v. Group operations therefore keep a state within its energy eigenspace.
在单个不可约块内使用Schur引理: Apply Schur's lemma to one irreducible block
如果一个不可约子空间只出现一次，对称Hamiltonian在其中只能是标量EαI: For an irreducible subspace occurring once, the symmetric Hamiltonian is EαI. Its dα independent basis states consequently share one energy.
若Vα出现mα次，对称性允许H在重数空间里混合副本，但不区分每个副本内部的dα个: If Vα occurs mα times, symmetry permits mixing within the multiplicity space but does not distinguish the dα partners within each copy.
Kα的不同本征值可以不同，每个本征值仍对应一组dα重态。除非额外重合，不会自动得: Different eigenvalues of Kα may differ in energy. Each still carries dα partners; the result need not be one mαdα-fold level.
用A₁加E模型区分保护与偶然: Separate protection from coincidence in A₁ plus E
H=aP_A₁+bP_E给出一重能级a和二重能级b。调到a=b时三个态重合，但并: H=aP_A₁+bP_E gives a singlet at a and a doublet at b. Tuning a=b creates a threefold coincidence, not a three-dimensional irreducible representation.
再用扰动检验保护来自哪里: Use a perturbation to identify the protecting condition
加入εuu†一般破坏全S₃对称，将E中的u、v分到b+ε和b。只有保留原群的扰动: Adding εuu† generally breaks full S₃ symmetry and separates the E partners to b+ε and b. Only perturbations preserving the original group must retain its protected partners.
